subject: Item figures (questions.figure_ids) are stored but never shown: qbank/practice renders stem without the figure
body:
Found while render-checking S23-E in WebKit: migration 0039 + importer store questions.figure_ids, but no qbank route returns them, so /practice/question/<id> (and blocks/exam) show a stem such as 'the region labelled A in the figure' with no figure. Repro (local stack): seed data/, open /practice/question/s23e-q04001.
Needed (seg23-core or the qbank owner): the item payload carries its figures (media id + signed/public URL + caption + alt), rendered above the options in practice, review and exam mode; figures are question media, so they may be shown before the answer (they never contain the key).
Mitigation in S23-E now: all 35 figure items ship with status 'in_review' (never reach students); every 05 area still has >= 6 published items per Step without them. I will flip them to published once item figures render. Other packs with figure items will hit the same gap.
